file(GLOB_RECURSE SRC_FILES *.cpp)
add_npu_library(npu_compiler_vpuipdpu_60XX
    ${SRC_FILES}
    LINK_LIBS
      PUBLIC
        npu_compiler_dialect_npureg60xx
        npu_compiler_dialect_vpu
        npu_compiler_dialect_vpuasm
        npu_compiler_dialect_vpuip
        npu_compiler_dialect_vpureg
        npu_compiler_vpuipdpu_40XX
        npu_compiler_dialect_vpuipdpu
        npu_compiler_vpuipdpu_50XX
      PRIVATE
        npu_60xx_firmware_headers
        # force MLIR headers to be generated by proxy-depending on npu_compiler_utils
        # TODO: #-127108
        npu_compiler_core
        npu_compiler_dialect_config
        npu_compiler_dialect_core
        npu_compiler_utils
        npu_compiler_vpuipdpu_37XX
        npu_core_utils
)
enable_lto_if_possible(npu_compiler_vpuipdpu_60XX)
